args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.2.9
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 0.18). Attempted rollback to v2.3.0, but that version is quarantined (CVE-2026-4417). Rolled back to v2.2.9, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened an incident.

**What I did:**
1. Confirmed checkout-api was unhealthy on v2.3.1 in all regions (error rate 0.18).
2. Attempted rollback to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release), but it was rejected as quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417.
3. Rolled back to **v2.2.9** (the most recent healthy, non-quarantined production release) across all regions — us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
4. Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback, which paged the on-call engineer.

Note: v2.3.0 remains quarantined, so v2.2.9 is the current production version.
